verdict.rationale: A government business registry could plausibly publish a public data API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web forms, PDF/mail/fax submission, and a CAPTCHA-gated keyless filing portal. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and no page documents API endpoints, a key-issuance path, or rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
